reason: E1 directly supports that nano-twinning enhances toughness in CrCoNi, and E2 supports that heterogeneous lattice strain promotes beneficial dislocation behaviors and strength-ductility synergy. However, no cited evidence demonstrates that these two features can be concurrently induced by a single processing route or that their combination yields enhanced toughness retention, which is a key premise of the hypothesis.
premises: Nano-twinning contributes an additional deformation mode that enhances toughness in CrCoNi alloys at cryogenic temperatures
Heterogeneous lattice strain causes unusual dislocation behaviors (multiple kinks/jogs, bidirectional cross slips) that produce strength-ductility synergy
Combining nano-twinning and heterogeneous lattice strain will enhance toughness retention in FCC HEAs
The proposed thermo-mechanical processing can concurrently induce nano-twinning and heterogeneous lattice strain
